foundations.statement: Exact original period data, tilt, coefficient fields, WSer/WIo maps and their prescribed compatibilities. Existence of the full records remains distinct from properties of their supplied maps.

Unique extension of the p-adic absolute value, nondegenerate trace pairing for finite characteristic-zero extensions, elementary PID and DVR criteria. The finite integral lattice, ramification relation and required completeness are proved in WIS1.

The coordinate construction and multiplication-by-p formula for perfect p-typical Witt rings, and the original tilt domain structure. Completeness, units, coefficient saturation and every approximation limit used here are proved explicitly.

Tensor-product universal property, finite determinants/adjugates, maximal ideals and the Jacobson criterion. The determinant argument replaces only a stronger intermediate supplier, while preserving the full original inclusion endpoint.

Original LocTied(p,P,AI), hence the IsStd instance used for realization, and the original crystalline-lattice realization premise are retained in the WIS26/WLD26 return; they are not claimed proved here.
